autoplay.description: Rotation interval in milliseconds. Omitting it leaves rotation off.

carousel-role-description.description: Accessible role description of the region.

current.description:
One-based leading slide. Setting it moves the carousel and clamps the index to
the available leading positions.

label.description: Required accessible name of the carousel region.

layout.description: Item arrangement. Full-screen uses a vertical, full-viewport slide.

loop.description: Whether navigating past one endpoint wraps to the other.

navigation.description: Whether to show the Previous and Next buttons. The viewport stays keyboard-operable.

next-label.description: Accessible label of the Next button.

pagination.description: Whether to show the noninteractive slide position indicator.

pause-label.description: Visible and accessible label of the Pause button.

play-label.description: Visible and accessible label of the Play button.

position-label.description: Accessible label of the position indicator.

previous-label.description: Accessible label of the Previous button.

slide-label.description: Spoken slide name and announcement. Use {index} and {count} as placeholders.

slide-role-description.description: Accessible role description of each slide group.

slides-per-move.description: Number of positions advanced by Previous, Next and automatic rotation.

slides-per-view.description:
Number of slides visible together in the single layout. Material 3 layouts
determine their own item widths.

--ki-carousel-control-backdrop-filter.description: Complete optional backdrop filter for the carousel controls.

--ki-carousel-control-bg.description: Surface of the carousel navigation and rotation controls.

--ki-carousel-control-bg-image.description: Optional image layered over the carousel control background color.

--ki-carousel-control-border.description: Visible control boundary against the surrounding surface.

--ki-carousel-control-fg.description: Text and glyph ink against the carousel control surface.

--ki-carousel-control-icon-size.description: Glyph size in the carousel navigation controls.

--ki-carousel-control-radius.description: Corner radius of the carousel controls.

--ki-carousel-control-shadow.description: Resting elevation of the carousel controls.

--ki-carousel-control-size.description: Resting carousel control size before applying the density target floor.

--ki-carousel-full-screen-block-size.description: Block size of the vertical carousel viewport.

--ki-carousel-gap.description: Gap between carousel slides and between the viewport and the controls.

--ki-carousel-preview-min-inline-size.description: Minimum inline size of a decorative carousel preview when space permits.

--ki-carousel-radius.description: Corner radius shared by the carousel viewport and slide surfaces.

--ki-control-border-width.description: Stroke width of the boundary of a compact control.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: An ordered, swipeable sequence with previous and next controls and position feedback.

ki-slide-change.description:
Reports the one-based index when the leading slide changes, also on
autoplay or a new `current`: it can fire without a gesture.

goTo.description: Moves to the requested one-based leading position within the available range.

announcement.description: Visually hidden live region for manual changes.

controls.description: Row containing slide position and navigation.

position.description: Position indicator and optional numeric position.

rotation.description: Play or Pause button when automatic rotation is configured.

viewport.description: Scroll-snap viewport and its keyboard focus outline.
